items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: He's the one that taught me how to pick and hold -- told me I had to keep my fingers down tight on the fingerboard.

ctx.x: He's the one that taught me how to pick and hold -- told me I had to keep my fingers down tight on the fingerboard. You can't do like that -- when you put your fingers down on a string bass, you've got to put your fingers down and keep it down there while you're picking. To give the note the full value, you understand? Otherwise it would be just plucking like.
